conclusions.statement_zh: 录像补强了 E1 两次草稿关闭缺陷的可见时序：先有未发送草稿，再新增另一标签页，关闭菜单消失时标签数直接从二变一；转换附近的全部源帧均未出现窗口内草稿确认框。
video_alone_proves: The two visible drafts existed before the respective tab-removal sequences.
The apparent modal before each close sequence is the new-terminal selector, not a discard confirmation.
In the fully sampled close-transition intervals, the context menu leads directly to one remaining raw tab without an in-window confirmation.
requires_correlated_evidence: Which internal session/task IDs were closed and which PTYs exited depends on the operator record and process snapshots; tab labels alone are truncated and positional shortcut labels can renumber.

Permanent disposal of the in-memory draft and absence of recovery are not independently proved by pixels alone. The video supports the visible removal sequence; controller/source and the existing operator/process evidence establish the lifecycle consequence.
The recording is limited to one main window. It cannot exclude another-window/native alert outside that filter, certify continuous foreground ownership, or measure PTY/model request counts.
coverage_limits: Only 215 distinct source frames were visually represented. The rest of the full recording was decoded but not visually inspected.
Every source frame was inspected only within the two stated short transition intervals, at contact-sheet scale. Outside those intervals the overview is approximately one frame per second.
No continuous player viewing, exhaustive all-frame privacy scan, or pixel-perfect inspection is claimed.
This is E1 pre-fix failure evidence. It is not a C9 fix validation and does not mark any full PRD case passed.
